description: This PHP class defines a custom dashboard dashlet for displaying opportunities grouped by lead source in SuiteCRM. It includes methods for rendering chart options, generating chart data, executing database queries, and rendering the visual element with embedded JavaScript for the chart presentation.

classes.name: OpportunitiesByLeadSourceDashlet
classes.description: A custom dashlet class extending DashletGenericChart to display opportunities data by lead source with chart visualization.

methods.name: displayOptions
methods.description: Prepares the options for the dashlet's display, including lead source filters.

methods.name: display
methods.description: Renders the dashlet chart, preparing data, configuring the chart, and generating the HTML and JavaScript for visualization.

methods.name: getChartData
methods.description: Executes the constructed SQL query and fetches opportunity data grouped by lead source.

methods.name: prepareChartData
methods.description: Processes raw data into chart-compatible labels and dataset, formatting totals with currency symbols.

methods.name: constructQuery
methods.description: Builds the SQL query to retrieve total opportunity amount and count per lead source, considering filters.
